Aegis Pulse: System Architecture & Design Specification
​1. Executive Summary & Vision
​Aegis Pulse is a dual-tier (B2B/B2C) real-time civil unrest intelligence, automated threat detection, and personal safety routing platform. By fusing municipal CCTV streams, computer vision (YOLOv8), targeted OSINT scraping, and hyper-local spatial caching, Aegis Pulse bridges the gap between raw data and actionable situational awareness.
​B2B Command Dashboard (Aegis Command): Provides security teams, journalists, and municipal operators with low-latency, unblurred live video feeds, AI-verified incident alerts, and operational risk metrics.
​B2C Mobile Application (Aegis Live): Empowers citizens with real-time hazard avoidance, safe-path routing, location-aware alerts, and offline-first survival guidance during high-stress civil events.
